verdict.reasoning: Printed page 850 (PDF p872), index: the left column ends with 'Mnemonic-name 67, 70, 194' and indented sub-entries ACCEPT 409, DISPLAY 435, Scope of 103, SEND 673; the right column continues at the top with three indented sub-entries on separate lines: 'SET statement, switch setting 516', 'SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph 194', 'WRITE statement 558', then 'MOD function 621'. The markdown (page-872.md lines 59-63) ends the  -indented Mnemonic-name list at 'SEND statement 673', then after a blank line has a single line '   SET statement, switch setting 516 SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph 194 WRITE statement 558' with no   indent and no line breaks, then a blank line. All words and page numbers are present, but the three index sub-entries are fused into one paragraph and detached from their parent entry, so the index structure (which entries are sub-entries of Mnemonic-name, and where one entry ends) is lost. The claim quotes both sources accurately. Structural, not normative (index only).
